Part-B (5 x 10 = 50 Marks

‘ Stem of the Question

2.a) Define Object-Oriented Programming. What are the key principles of
OOP?

2.b) Explain the concept of garbage collection in Java. Why is it important?

OR

2.c) Discuss the difference between method overriding and method

overloading with examples.

Illustrate the concept of parameter passing between objects in OOP.

What is the difference between a base class and a subclass? Give an
example.

3.b) Define a Java interface Shape with a method area(). Implement it in
two classes Circle and Rectangle and display their areas.

OR

3.c) Explain the concept of CLASSPATH and its significance in using
packages.

3.d) Write a Java program that defines an interface Printable and

implements it in a class Document to print a message.

Describe the difference between termination and resumptive exception
handling models.

4.b) Write a Java program that creates two threads: one prints even

numbers, the other prints odd numbers up to 10.
OR

4.c) Explain the life cycle of a thread in Java with a neat diagram.

4.d) Write a Java program to demonstrate the use of try, catch, and finally
blocks.

Explain the delegation event model with a suitable diagram.
5.b) Write a Java AWT program that responds to a button click using.
